head.name: @fzlt/core/props
head.lead: A kit of small low-poly models for @fzlt/core/diorama scenes, so a new diorama starts furnished. Each prop is a function prop(d, opts) that adds a group root (its size is the prop's footprint, so its blob shadow fits) and its parts resting on it, at pos, turned by rot (yaw) and sized by scale, in soft pastel colours you can override by key; it returns the root. Move, turn, tilt, tint or hide the root and the whole prop follows; d.root(d.pick(x, y)) on any part gives the root (its tag is the prop's name unless you pass one). - Sets: nature (pineTree, roundTree, bush, rocks, cactus), town (house, shop, lamppost, bench, fence, trafficCone, crates), coast (lighthouse, dock, buoy) and display vehicles (car, truck). Import only the props you use: each is its own function. - Units: about a metre (a house is 2.4 wide); local x is a prop's width, z its depth and +z its front (doors, windows, a car's side). fence and dock segments join end to end along x at FENCE_STEP and DOCK_STEP × scale. - Variants: seed (an integer) picks heights, widths, turns and counts from integer maths, so every player who builds the same seed gets the same scene. Each jitter is one of eight steps, so the diorama's mesh cache stays small however many seeds a scene uses. - Sorting: each prop is its own diorama cluster (named by its id) unless you pass cluster, and its parts are layered low to high, so props in a row never interleave. Make what they stand on a fixed cluster (d.cluster("floor", { fixed: 0 })), as clusters anchored on a point sort far to near. - Colours: every prop reads colors[key] before its own default, and the keys are shared across props (wood, roof, glass, metal, lamp, …), so one object re-themes a scene (a night set). Adding a prop allocates only what d.add does for its parts (pass an id; without one, a name is made from a counter). Nothing runs per frame: props are data in the diorama, drawn by its draw().

blocks.code: import { pineTree, roundTree, bush, rocks, … } from "https://fizlet.com/dist/props.js";

blocks.label: NPM · @fzlt/core
blocks.code:
npm install @fzlt/core
import { pineTree, roundTree, bush, rocks, … } from "@fzlt/core/props";

blocks.label: IN SHORT
blocks.code:
import { house, pineTree, car } from "@fzlt/core/props"; // only what you use
d.cluster("floor", { fixed: 0 }); // what props stand on draws first
house(d, { id: "home", on: "floor", pos: [2, 0, -1], rot: 0.3 }); // a group root + its parts
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) pineTree(d, { on: "floor", pos: [i * 2 - 4, 0, 3], seed: matchSeed + i }); // same seed, same trees
car(d, { on: "floor", colors: { paint: "#6db0cf" } }); // any colour by key
d.root(d.pick(x, y)); // a click on any part → the prop's root (tag "house")
